assets.name: Wall section
assets.description: Revision 2: coursed limestone footing and plastered mudbrick body, parapet and curb (troy-limestone, troy-mudbrick), every box face mapped in world units so courses match on ends, top and the battered footing. Owner-directed material pass, 2 October 2026.

assets.name: City gate
assets.description: Revision 2 (material pass): coursed limestone footings and plastered mudbrick piers, gate head, parapet and merlons (troy-limestone, troy-mudbrick) mapped from world position at the pack tiles; geometry, part names, door pivots and the open and close clips are revision 1's. Owner-directed material pass, 2 October 2026.

assets.name: Trojan Walk-in House
assets.description: Revision 2 (material pass): limestone footings and hearth, plastered mudbrick walls, floor, ramp and roof (troy-limestone, troy-mudbrick) mapped from world position in metres instead of one stretched tile per face; geometry, part names, the roof subtree and the ladder are revision 1's. Owner-directed material pass, 2 October 2026.

assets.name: Troy Citadel Temple Hall
assets.description: Revision 2 (material pass): coursed limestone platform, footings, column bases, hearth rim, furnishings and parapet, plastered mudbrick walls and roof slab (troy-limestone, troy-mudbrick) as textured resources mapped from world position; geometry, part names and the roof subtree are revision 1's. Owner-directed material pass, 2 October 2026.

assets.name: Greek War Galley
assets.description: Troy-style low-poly black-hulled galley, 17.53 m overall length, one mast with a billowing set linen sail and blue bands, 28 rowing oars, a starboard steering oar, rigging, benches, and tapered end decks. 6480 triangles, 4 materials and 4 draw calls. Reviewed in material-faithful GPU views including underside. Structural QA accepted; compound-mesh intersection checks remain partial. Established legacy GLB exporter and default editable delivery.

assets.name: Greek soldier
assets.description: Greek (Achaean) infantryman derived from trojan-soldier r_036bd9d29d9747fa8d50899e089c695b. Body, proportions, joints (Joint_hips, spine, neck, head, shoulder/elbow/wrist, hip/knee/ankle _left/_right), socket_hand_left/right, bronze leaf sword and both clips (idle 3 s loop, attack 1.5 s one-shot) are unchanged. Changes: cuirass, kilt, sleeves and crest in greek-blue linen (troy-linen tinted 0x4875bd, palette #2f4a6b); new tall bronze helmet of stepped tiers (boar's-tusk style) rising to a plume knob, keeping the cheek and neck guards; a blue horsehair plume (node Mesh_crest) springs from the knob and arches down the back. Root node GreekSoldier. 2,000 triangles, 3 pinned pack materials, 24 draw calls; height 1.919 m with plume.

assets.name: Trojan soldier
assets.description: Rigid-segment low-poly Trojan soldier facing +Z. Crimson linen cuirass with shoulder flaps, kilt and sleeves; bronze crested helmet with cheek guards, belt and greaves; bronze leaf sword (~0.75 m) held in socket_hand_right with its 0.03 m x 0.11 m grip centred on its origin along +Y. Both fists close to the pack grip; socket_hand_left is free for a shield. Named joints (Joint_hips, spine, neck, head, shoulder/elbow/wrist, hip/knee/ankle _left/_right). Clips: idle (3 s loop, breathing guard) and attack (1.5 s one-shot forehand cut, feet planted via leg IK). 1,860 triangles, 3 pinned pack materials (troy-linen tinted crimson and skin, troy-bronze tinted bronze), 24 draw calls. Rest pose = idle frame 0.

assets.name: Achilles
assets.description: Achilles, the Greek champion, derived from greek-soldier r_647e60b4c8c94640aca8a8266a371b0f. Body, proportions, joints (Joint_hips, spine, neck, head, shoulder/elbow/wrist, hip/knee/ankle _left/_right), socket_hand_left/right, bronze leaf sword and both clips (idle 3 s loop, attack 1.5 s one-shot) are unchanged: all 32 animation channels and every joint rest transform compared equal to the Greek soldier. Changes: Dendra-style bronze armour. The cuirass keeps the linen cuirass profile and shoulder flaps but is cast in bronze with a high neck guard; curved bronze shoulder guards ride the shoulder joints (Mesh_pauldron_left/right); two bronze hoops (Mesh_lames) girdle the top of the blue kilt; a bronze stilt on the boar's-tusk helmet carries a tall blue horsehair crest (node Mesh_crest) that rises over the brow and sweeps back. Greek blue stays on kilt, sleeves and crest. Root node Achilles. 2,424 triangles, 3 pinned pack materials, 27 draw calls; height 2.043 m with crest (Greek soldier 1.919 m, body unchanged). Sampled attack (10 ms): sword clears the crest by at least 17.9 cm; thighs clear the lames by at least 0.6 cm.

assets.name: Hector
assets.description: Hector, made from trojan-soldier r_036bd9d29d9747fa8d50899e089c695b with the same body proportions, joints, hand grips and idle/attack clips (all 32 animation channels and every joint rest transform unchanged). Changes: bronze bell cuirass with flared rim and bronze shoulder plates (was crimson linen); crimson waist sash (was bronze belt); taller, deeper crimson horsehair crest (overall height 1.913 -> 2.013 m, crest only); new crimson cloak pinned at both shoulders with bronze brooches, hanging to above the knees, rigid on the spine joint. Root node Hector. 2,224 triangles, 3 pack materials (troy-linen crimson and skin tints, troy-bronze).

assets.name: Horse
assets.description: Revision 2 (slimmer body): the barrel, chest and croup are 0.8 to 0.84 as wide as deep, the bulges and neck follow, the harness hugs the narrower barrel and the legs hang 0.16 m off centre; materials, pivots, joint names and the Stand and Gallop clips are revision 1's. Owner-directed, 2 October 2026.

assets.name: Breached wall
assets.description: Revision 3 (breached section): coursed limestone on the footings, spurs, apron and half the tumbled blocks, plastered mudbrick on the bodies, fractures, parapets, merlons, curbs and the other blocks (troy-limestone, troy-mudbrick), every box face mapped in world units. Owner-directed material pass, 2 October 2026.

assets.name: Late Bronze Age war chariot
assets.description: Child revision adds a hollow brown quiver with five bronze-tipped javelins on +X, the right side of the +Z-facing car, mounted by two bronze brackets. Both rims increase radial thickness from 0.08 to 0.12 m and width from 0.09 to 0.15 m, preserving 1.2 m wheel diameter. GPU overall/detail views reviewed; mount contacts verified at both ends, quiver-wheel rest surface clearance 0.0383 m. Exact exported comparison preserves all other pre-existing meshes, rest transforms, materials and both wheel_spin channels. Wheel motion sampled at phases 0, 0.073, 0.31, 0.68, 1. 4156 triangles, 16 draw calls, 4 tints of 3 pinned pack materials. QA accepted with inherited 9-image budget warning; destination scene performance untested.

assets.name: Bronze Age Sword
assets.description: Leaf-shaped bronze blade (0.55m, diamond section) with straight guard, timber grip r0.03 l0.11 centred on origin, bronze pommel. 208 tris, 2 materials (troy-bronze, troy-timber).

assets.name: Round shield
assets.description: Round shield 0.92m diameter: domed bronze face and rim with central boss, hide-covered board back, pack-size vertical hand grip (r 0.03, 0.11 long) centred at origin on bronze brackets plus a leather forearm loop on struts. 2 pack materials, 1272 triangles.

assets.name: Bow, arrows and quiver
assets.description: Low-poly recurved composite bow with string, three fanned arrows with bronze points and vanes, and a wooden quiver with bronze reinforcement bands and shoulder strap. Hand grip 0.03 m radius, 0.11 m long.

assets.name: Trojan Horse
assets.description: Hollow lofted timber horse (boolean-cut shell) standing on a four-wheeled deck. A hinged hatch in the belly opens via the hatch_open clip; four wheel_* nodes spin via wheels_roll. Built from pinned troy-timber and troy-bronze only, tinted to palette. +Z forward per the Troy project; origin on the ground at the footprint centre.

assets.name: Battle before the gate
assets.description: Revision 2: s50's composition recomposed from the material-pass revisions (wall revision 2, breached wall revision 3, gate, house, temple and horse revision 2) by review/troy-refine/scene/recompose.mjs; the scene helpers and the layout are revision 1's byte for byte. Owner-directed, 2 October 2026.
